  echo: false

params:
  experiment_name: "transfer_bandits_choice_textbox"
  version: "pilot_C"
  data_source: "experiment"  # "experiment" (human) | "test" (synthetic)
  prediction_context_beta_method: "theta_betas"
  example_session_expert_first: null
  example_session_novice_first: null
---

```{r setup}
library(here)
library(dotenv)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)

dotenv::load_dot_env(here::here(".env"))

output_data_dir <- Sys.getenv("OUTPUT_DATA_DIR")
if (output_data_dir == "") {
  stop("OUTPUT_DATA_DIR env var is not set. Source .env before rendering.")
}
eval_data_dir        <- file.path(output_data_dir, "eval", "data")
eval_fig_dir         <- file.path(output_data_dir, "eval", "figures")
per_session_fig_dir  <- file.path(eval_fig_dir, "hybrid_model_pipeline_sessions")
if (!dir.exists(eval_fig_dir))        dir.create(eval_fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
if (!dir.exists(per_session_fig_dir)) dir.create(per_session_fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)

source(here::here("reports", "r", "hybrid_pipeline_plots.R"))

data_source <- params$data_source
if (!(data_source %in% c("experiment", "test"))) {
  stop("params$data_source must be 'experiment' or 'test'")
}

if (data_source == "experiment") {
  trial_path  <- file.path(eval_data_dir, "experiment_trial_predictions.csv")
  cutoff_path <- file.path(eval_data_dir, "experiment_cutoff_model_predictions.csv")
} else {
  trial_path  <- file.path(eval_data_dir, "test_trial_model_predictions.csv")
  cutoff_path <- file.path(eval_data_dir, "test_cutoff_model_predictions.csv")
}
stopifnot(file.exists(trial_path))
stopifnot(file.exists(cutoff_path))
```

## Data source

```{r data-source-info}
cat(sprintf("Data source: %s\n", data_source))
cat(sprintf("  Trial CSV:  %s\n", trial_path))
cat(sprintf("  Cutoff CSV: %s\n", cutoff_path))
cat(sprintf("  Prediction context beta_method: %s\n",
            params$prediction_context_beta_method))
```

## Load data

```{r load-data}
# guess_max=Inf prevents readr from type-guessing on early NaN rows (see
# reports/eval_report.qmd for the precedent).
trial_df  <- read_csv(trial_path,  show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = Inf)
cutoff_df <- read_csv(cutoff_path, show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = Inf)

# Only include watch-first sequences (hybrid report is structured for them).
trial_df  <- trial_df  %>% filter(game_sequence %in% VALID_GAME_SEQUENCES)
cutoff_df <- cutoff_df %>% filter(game_sequence %in% VALID_GAME_SEQUENCES)
if ("segment_order" %in% colnames(cutoff_df)) {
  cutoff_df <- cutoff_df %>% filter(segment_order == "watch-first")
}

cat(sprintf("Trial rows:  %d  (sessions: %d)\n",
            nrow(trial_df), dplyr::n_distinct(trial_df$session_id)))
cat(sprintf("Cutoff rows: %d  (sessions: %d)\n",
            nrow(cutoff_df), dplyr::n_distinct(cutoff_df$session_id)))

if (data_source == "test") {
  test_methods <- unique(trial_df$beta_method)
  if (!any(names(BETA_METHOD_TO_PRIOR) %in% test_methods)) {
    message("NOTE: synthetic trial CSV contains beta_method values ",
            paste(test_methods, collapse = ", "),
            " — hybrid prior groupings will be empty. The eval pipeline does ",
            "not emit per-prior Thompson rollouts for synthetic test data; ",
            "only the cross-prior prediction rows will populate.")
  }
}
```

```{r resolve-examples}
resolve_example <- function(df, game_seq, override) {
  if (!is.null(override) && !is.na(override) && nzchar(override)) {
    return(override)
  }
  ids <- df %>% filter(game_sequence == game_seq) %>%
    distinct(session_id) %>% dplyr::pull(session_id) %>% sort()
  if (length(ids) == 0) NULL else ids[1]
}
example_expert_sid <- resolve_example(trial_df, GAME_SEQUENCE_EXPERT_FIRST,
                                      params$example_session_expert_first)
example_novice_sid <- resolve_example(trial_df, GAME_SEQUENCE_NOVICE_FIRST,
                                      params$example_session_novice_first)

cat(sprintf("Example expert-first session: %s\n",
            if (is.null(example_expert_sid)) "<none found>" else example_expert_sid))
cat(sprintf("Example novice-first session: %s\n",
            if (is.null(example_novice_sid)) "<none found>" else example_novice_sid))
```

## Per-session view

### Expert-first example

```{r per-session-expert, fig.width=18, fig.height=48}
if (!is.null(example_expert_sid)) {
  plot_session(trial_df, cutoff_df, example_expert_sid,
               params$prediction_context_beta_method)
} else {
  cat("No expert-first session available.\n")
}
```


### All sessions (saved to subdirectory)

```{r save-all-sessions}
saved_paths <- save_per_session_figures(
  trial_df, cutoff_df, per_session_fig_dir,
  context_beta_method = params$prediction_context_beta_method
)
cat(sprintf("Saved %d per-session figures to %s\n",
            length(saved_paths), per_session_fig_dir))
```

## Cross-session view

### Expert-first

```{r cross-expert, fig.width=18, fig.height=54}
p_cross_ef <- plot_cross_session(trial_df, cutoff_df,
                                 GAME_SEQUENCE_EXPERT_FIRST,
                                 params$prediction_context_beta_method)
ggsave(file.path(eval_fig_dir, "hybrid_pipeline_cross_session_expert_first.png"),
       p_cross_ef, width = 18, height = 54, dpi = 150, bg = "white",
       limitsize = FALSE)
p_cross_ef
```
